purpose: UI-14 evidence timeline: message-bubble states and content shapes that the Figure 4 fixture does not cover — emoji-only text, long unbroken text, multiline text, long wrapped text, and the full local delivery-state ladder (Queued/Sent/Delivered/Seen/Failed). Injected into an isolated data dir by figure4_fixture.py --spec and captured by scripts/ui14_states_evidence.sh.

source.notes: UI-14 card verification requires: emoji-only, long text, multiline, failed and read states (card step 'Verification required before Done'). This spec is dev/QA-only and never touches production data paths.

conversation.notes: Same identity seed and remote key as the Figure 4 fixture so the conversation row opens through the same MCP action.
